attribution-off.summary: Leave Claude Code's name out of your commits and pull requests
attribution-off.why: Your commits and pull requests then hold only what you and your project put there.

claudeCode.whenMissing: Claude Code adds a co-author line to your commits and "Generated with Claude Code" to your pull requests, and cloud and Remote Control sessions add a link to the session.
claudeCode.whenOlderForm: Claude Code leaves out the co-author line and "Generated with Claude Code", but cloud and Remote Control sessions still add a link to the session.

feedback-survey-off.summary: Turn off Claude Code's session quality survey
feedback-survey-off.why: The survey interrupts your work, and can ask to upload the session's transcript.

claudeCode.whenMissing: Claude Code now and then asks you to rate the session, and can ask to upload its transcript.

remote-control-at-startup.summary: Connect Remote Control when each Claude Code session starts
remote-control-at-startup.why: You can then pick up any session from claude.ai/code or the Claude app, with nothing to run first.

claudeCode.whenMissing: Remote Control connects only when you run /remote-control, unless your organization or Claude Code turns it on for everyone.
claudeCode.needs: It needs a claude.ai sign-in on a Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise plan, and on Team and Enterprise, an Owner must turn Remote Control on first. Where it can't connect, each session shows a notice; switch it off in /config.
